fact: The Constitutional Court, sitting on 24 August 2021, reviewed law n°025/2021 on the regulation of electronic transactions, referred by the Prime Minister, and found articles 6, 82, 115 and 119 constitutional subject to rewording.
title: Décision de la Cour Constitutionnelle sur la loi n°025/2021 portant réglementation des transactions électroniques
publisher: Cour Constitutionnelle de la République Gabonaise
